correctness.rationale: For each n>=3 the bound by independent leaves gives at most n; odd n cannot have n alternating rung leaves. If an even cycle prism saturates n, all leaves occupy one bipartition and 3-neighbour star centers partition them, so 3 divides n. Explicit cyclic words of lengths 3 through 11 achieve the values; checking local triples and splicing at state (0,2) proves constructions for every n. In case 6 divides n, center coverage forces x_(i-1)+x_i+x_(i+1)=1, whence period 3, exactly three phases per bipartition. The standalone independently coded graph-conflict DP checks all n=3..40, direct witness checking n=3..200, and six exact n=6 maximizers. These checks corroborate, not replace, the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Originality is restricted to the exact mod-six packing number for all cycle prisms and the sixfold equality classification. The founding 2022 article treats paths/cycles and several other basic families; Brešar et al. 2024/2025 prove general graph-product inequalities and hypercube values, with the independent-set upper bound used here but no full prism exact value or rigidity classification; Das–Santra 2026 treat other graph classes and algorithms. Full relevant sections of these primary sources were read and searched for prism/ladder, and published-finding corpus searches returned different invariants on prisms and open packing. Comparisons did not uncover a statement implying the combined theorem. Terminological alternatives and unindexed sources remain a genuine priority risk.

value.rationale: The cycle prism is a canonical cubic product graph; exact edge-open packing numbers were not delivered by broad graph-product inequalities. Saturating the independence upper bound is governed by a new divisibility-three obstruction combined with even cycle parity, and precisely six extremal configurations appear at multiples of six. This is a natural complete infinite-family classification and a structural equality phenomenon, not a table recomputation or arbitrary sample.
